title: Re-check the 146 kept notes the sort could not verify
why: Item 355 sort, coordinator 14:05 CST Nov 7: 9 Sonnet agents sorted 1,629 notes and debts on main 174b005c1. Fix 184 (166 small, 18 large), delete 86, keep 1,359 (146 of them unverified). Lists: branch claude/clever-planck-oynpfh 759486de5, docs/plans/notes-sort/.
note: Its list is in docs/plans/notes-sort/ on branch claude/clever-planck-oynpfh. Each lane carries the tag cs-step:notes-keep-reverify. Coordinator pick, 14:08 CST Nov 7 (undoable): option A. A kept note gets `Fix: step:` or `already fixed` where that is true. `Fix: none` lines go in waves of about 200 per PR, with Until dates spread across the cap, so the expiries do not all land at once. The cap is page item 360. Result, 14:23 CST Nov 7: of 146 rows, 18 fix (steps notes-fix-reverify-small and notes-fix-reverify-large), 18 delete, 110 keep: 86 rare and harmless, 18 for the owner to decide, 6 that need the Mac. The 18 owner rows are not on the page yet. Prose wave (owner 20:24 CST Nov 11, item 521; retrospective's sort 20:41 CST): prose, first wave. Fold in (coordinator 23:52 CST Nov 11): the batch 88 prose judge flagged 5 docs/debts/notes.md lines as unbacked and left 58 unjudged (UNKNOWN, call cap). The rebuild re-checks those 5; any it does not cover become one small prose step. Waves 1-7 of the rebuilt Fix lines (#2623-#2629) landed in batch 95 (PR #2639, a30edcf08, merged by 04:08 CST Nov 12). Still open: the 6 owner notes (page items 528-533). Coordinator pick, process-only (04:21 CST Nov 12), four flagged notes: scratchpad-shared-per-session gets Fix: step:scratchpad-file-ownership; comment-narration-limits, merge-remedy-hits-role-refusal and other-clone-unread-writers each become a debt record in docs/debts/. Triage flag: step scratchpad-file-ownership is already done, so that Fix line should point to an open step (scratch-folder-per-agent or scratch-rm-other-agent) or close the note. After batch 102 merges, this lane takes the 7 duplicate notes batch runner 10 found (coordinator 07:33 CST Nov 12). Batch 102 merged as 2a7521db9 (08:04 CST Nov 12), carrying #2648 (Fix lines for the 21 kept notes waves 1-7 skipped) and #2649 (three notes become debt records; the scratchpad note gets a Fix line). Step stays open: the 6 owner notes and the 7 duplicate notes remain; this lane now takes the 7 duplicates and judge-flags-batch101 and -batch102.
